name: Finite Element Method in Water Resources Engineering
description: Introduction to finite element method; solving of algebraic equations; discrete method; weighted residual method; 1D, 2D, 3D - Galerkin finite element formulation; higher-order finite elements; isoparametric formulation; numerical integration methods; explicit and implicit time marching schemes for unsteady problems; solving non-linear problems using FEM; solving application problems on flow and solute transport through porous media, groundwater flow in unsaturated zone, confined and unconfined aquifers, Navier-Stokes equations, flow through earthen dams.
